articles.title: CCTV Captures Stray Dog Attack on Girl in Greater Noida; Residents Demand Urgent Action
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A young girl was injured after being attacked by stray dogs while playing outside her home in Greater Noida's Beta-1 area, with the entire incident captured on CCTV. The attack took place on Sunday evening in B Block of Sector Beta One.

body.html:
A young girl was injured after being attacked by stray dogs while playing outside her home in Greater Noida's Beta-1 area, with the entire incident captured on CCTV.

The attack took place on Sunday evening in B Block of Sector Beta One. According to local residents, the girl was playing with other children when a pack of stray dogs suddenly appeared and chased her.

CCTV footage shows two dogs knocking the girl to the ground before biting her on her arms and legs. Despite her attempts to defend herself, the dogs continued the attack before eventually running away.

The injured girl sustained multiple bite injuries and bruises from the fall. She was provided medical treatment following the incident.

In a separate incident reported from the same locality, a woman and a child were also allegedly attacked by a pack of stray dogs while walking in the area. Both sustained multiple bite injuries and were rushed to a nearby hospital by local residents.

Following the incidents, residents have raised serious concerns over the growing stray dog menace in the sector.

Harendra Bhati, General Secretary of the Beta One Residents' Welfare Association (RWA), said stray dogs have become a major threat to children, women and elderly residents.

He alleged that repeated complaints have been submitted to the Greater Noida Authority, but no effective action has been taken so far. He urged the authorities to immediately address the issue and ensure the safety of residents.

The CCTV footage of the attack has gone viral on social media, reigniting concerns over stray dog attacks in residential areas.

articles.title: Iron Rods, Viral Videos and Chaos: Financial Dispute Sparks Violent Street Clash in Belagavi
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A violent clash allegedly triggered by a financial dispute broke out between two groups in Lakshmi Layout of Gokak town in Karnataka's Belagavi district, leaving a 16-year-old boy seriously injured.

body.html:
A violent clash allegedly triggered by a financial dispute broke out between two groups in Lakshmi Layout of Gokak town in Karnataka's Belagavi district, leaving a 16-year-old boy seriously injured.

According to police sources, members of both groups attacked each other with iron rods and other weapons, creating panic in the locality.

The injured teenager has been identified as Varun Santosh Gollar, who sustained serious injuries in the violence and was admitted to a private hospital in Belagavi for treatment.

Several mobile phone videos of the incident have surfaced on social media, showing individuals allegedly assaulting each other with iron rods. The footage has since gone viral.

The clash also caused damage to a car, a Bolero vehicle and the windows of a nearby house.

Police personnel from the Gokak Town Police Station rushed to the spot, brought the situation under control and conducted an inspection.

A case has been registered against members of the Appasaheb Bhajantri family, and further investigation is underway.

Police are also examining the viral videos and other evidence to determine the sequence of events and identify everyone involved in the violence.

articles.title: Give Us Free Alcohol': Rowdy Sheeter, Gang Allegedly Vandalise Three Bars in Kolar, CCTV Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of alleged hooliganism has emerged from Karnataka's Kolar district, where a rowdy sheeter and his associates reportedly attacked and vandalised three bars after being denied free alcohol.

body.html:
A shocking case of alleged hooliganism has emerged from Karnataka's Kolar district, where a rowdy sheeter and his associates reportedly attacked and vandalised three bars after being denied free alcohol.

The main accused have been identified as Pratap, also known as Vishwanath Pratap Gowda, a rowdy sheeter previously externed to Mysuru district, and his associate Murugesh, who is facing charges in the "Biklu Shiva" murder case. Police said three other individuals were also involved in the attacks.

According to investigators, the group targeted three establishments in Malur taluk: M.S. Bar in Masti, a bar near Tirumala Residency at Berike Gadi in Gangasandra, and a bar and restaurant in Toralakki village.

The most serious incident took place at the Toralakki village bar, where CCTV footage allegedly shows the masked gang entering the premises late at night.

Police said the accused took a beer parcel and attempted to leave without making payment. When the staff objected, they allegedly demanded free alcohol and insisted that they should be served without paying.

The situation quickly escalated as the group allegedly smashed liquor bottles, vandalised property and assaulted a cashier identified as Varun.

The entire incident was captured on CCTV cameras, and the footage has since gone viral on social media.

Following the attacks, the Masti Police registered a case and launched a search operation to trace the absconding accused. Senior police officials, including the Superintendent of Police, visited the affected establishments and inspected the damage.

Police said further investigation is underway and efforts are continuing to arrest all those involved.

The incident has raised concerns among local residents over increasing criminal activity and the alleged involvement of repeat offenders in acts of violence and vandalism.

#Kolar #Karnataka #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #CCTV

articles.title: Army Jawan Beaten to Death After Wife Allegedly Finds Him with Two Women; Four Surrender to Police
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 32-year-old Indian Army personnel was allegedly beaten to death by his wife and her family members after he was reportedly found with two women at his residence in Telangana's Medak town on Monday.

body.html:
A 32-year-old Indian Army personnel was allegedly beaten to death by his wife and her family members after he was reportedly found with two women at his residence in Telangana's Medak town on Monday.

The deceased has been identified as Ponnam Kumar Goud, who was serving in the Indian Army and was posted in Uttarakhand. He had recently returned to his home in the Military Colony area of Medak while on leave.

According to preliminary police reports, Kumar Goud was allegedly found in a compromising situation with two women when his wife unexpectedly arrived at the house.

Police said the woman, allegedly enraged by her husband's suspected extramarital relationship, informed her parents and brother about the incident.

Soon after, the wife's family members reached the residence, where an argument reportedly escalated into a violent assault. Investigators alleged that Kumar Goud was attacked by his wife, father-in-law, mother-in-law and brother-in-law, sustaining severe injuries.

He succumbed to his injuries at the scene.

Following the incident, the four accused reportedly surrendered before the Medak Town Police Station.

Police have registered a case and launched an investigation to establish the exact sequence of events and the circumstances leading to the Army personnel's death.

Further details are awaited as the investigation progresses.

The incident has also reignited discussion on domestic violence and the legal framework surrounding marital disputes. In 2018, the Supreme Court struck down Section 497 of the Indian Penal Code, decriminalising adultery and holding that consensual relationships between adults cannot be treated as a criminal offence, while clarifying that adultery may still be a ground for divorce or other civil proceedings.

#Medak #Telangana #ArmyJawan #BreakingNews #CrimeNews

articles.title: Fake Government Jobs, Real Crores: Father-Daughter Duo Arrested for ₹5.3 Crore Recruitment Scam
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Central Crime Branch (CCB) of Bengaluru has arrested a father-daughter duo for allegedly cheating unemployed youth of more than ₹5.3 crore by promising government jobs and issuing fake appointment letters.

body.html:
The Central Crime Branch (CCB) of Bengaluru has arrested a father-daughter duo for allegedly cheating unemployed youth of more than ₹5.3 crore by promising government jobs and issuing fake appointment letters.

The accused have been identified as MA Mansoor Ahmed and his daughter, Shamshad Begum MM, an MBA graduate.

According to police, the duo operated fake training centres in Mumbai, Bengaluru and Kolkata, where they targeted job seekers by promising appointments in various central and state government departments, including the Railways, Income Tax, Health and Social Welfare departments.

Investigators alleged that the accused issued fake appointment letters to victims and, in some cases, even paid them three to four months' salary to gain their trust and convince other aspirants of the scheme's authenticity.

Police said more than 40 job seekers from North Karnataka were allegedly duped, with the accused collecting over ₹5.3 crore through the fraudulent recruitment racket.

The scam came to light after one of the victims, Sangamesh Rachaiah Vastrad, filed a complaint with the CCB in November last year.

Following the complaint, the Organised Crime Wing (East) of the CCB launched an investigation, verifying documents and examining financial transactions allegedly carried out between 2023 and 2025. Officials said most of the payments were made through online transactions.

Based on the findings, the father and daughter were arrested on June 4 and taken into police custody for further interrogation.

Police are also investigating the possible involvement of other family members and associates linked to the alleged fraud.

Efforts are underway to trace the money collected from the victims and identify any additional beneficiaries of the recruitment scam.

#Bengaluru #JobScam #GovernmentJobs #CCB #BreakingNews

articles.title: Woman, Newborn Rescued After Allegedly Being Locked Inside House for Months by Husband in Sangrur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing case of alleged domestic abuse has emerged from Sangrur city in Punjab, where a woman and her two-month-old baby were rescued after reportedly being locked inside their home by her husband. The incident took place in the Bagguana settlement area.

body.html:
A disturbing case of alleged domestic abuse has emerged from Sangrur city in Punjab, where a woman and her two-month-old baby were rescued after reportedly being locked inside their home by her husband.

The incident took place in the Bagguana settlement area. According to police, the woman managed to attract attention by shouting for help through a window after enduring prolonged confinement and abuse.

Hearing her cries, local residents gathered outside the house and informed the police.

A team from City-1 Police Station rushed to the spot and, with the assistance of local residents, broke open the lock and safely rescued the woman and her infant child.

According to the victim, her husband, identified as Johnny, had subjected her to years of abuse and had recently confined her and the baby inside the house. She alleged that she was frequently assaulted and was not provided adequate food.

The woman further claimed that her husband is addicted to drugs and would often beat her for money. She also alleged that both she and her newborn child were deprived of proper food and care.

Police said the accused has a criminal history and is allegedly involved in cases of theft and robbery. According to local residents, he had been released from jail around 10 days before the incident.

Ward councillor Harpreet Singh Sekhon said he contacted the police immediately after learning about the situation from residents. He added that disputes within the family had reportedly been ongoing for the past four years and that several attempts had been made to resolve the matter, but the accused's behaviour had not changed.

Station House Officer Sukhdev Singh confirmed that the woman and child were rescued safely. He said the victim informed police that she no longer wished to live with her husband and wanted strict legal action against him.

Following the rescue, police sent the woman to her parents' home for her safety and welfare.

A case has been registered against the accused under relevant sections of law, and he has been arrested. Further investigation is underway.

#Sangrur #Punjab #DomesticViolence #BreakingNews

articles.title: Slaps Fly at Har Ki Pauri: Viral Video of Youth and Women Fighting Leads to Arrest
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video showing a heated altercation between a young man and three women at Haridwar's Har Ki Pauri has gone viral on social media, prompting police action. The incident took place early Monday morning (8 June 2026), and the accused youth has since been arrested.

body.html:
A video showing a heated altercation between a young man and three women at Haridwar's Har Ki Pauri has gone viral on social media, prompting police action. The incident took place early Monday morning (8 June 2026), and the accused youth has since been arrested.

According to reports, the incident occurred around 5 a.m. during Adhik Maas. The young man, identified as Ravi Chauhan, had reportedly visited the temple area for पूजा and was helping clean the premises.

Police said the dispute began when some women were watering a Peepal tree using a plastic bucket, allegedly causing water to spill across the area. Ravi reportedly objected and asked them to avoid creating a mess and carry out the activity in an orderly manner.

The objection allegedly led to an argument between the two sides.

A viral video of the incident shows three women arguing with the young man. As he attempts to leave, reportedly saying he would return with a friend, the women follow him and continue the confrontation.

During the exchange, one of the women confronts him, following which the young man allegedly slaps her. Another woman then slaps him in return, and he allegedly strikes back. The situation quickly escalates into a physical scuffle, with the three women and the young man exchanging blows while bystanders record the incident.

Police said the woman involved regularly visits Har Ki Pauri during Adhik Maas for prayers and meditation. Authorities are examining all aspects of the case, including the authenticity of the viral video, the sequence of events and the circumstances that led to the altercation.

City Circle Officer Shishupal Negi said police have launched a detailed investigation and are gathering statements from those present at the scene.

Based on a complaint filed by the woman, police have registered a case against Ravi Chauhan and arrested him. Further investigation is underway to determine the exact cause of the dispute and whether any other factors were involved.

#Haridwar #HarKiPauri #ViralVideo #Uttarakhand #BreakingNews

articles.title: Son Assaults 72-Year-Old Father Over Property Dispute, Then Father Pleads for His Release
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident from Uttar Pradesh's Saharanpur has sparked outrage after a son was caught on CCTV allegedly assaulting his 72-year-old father in the middle of a street over a property dispute. The incident occurred on Monday in the Qutubsher police station area.

body.html:
A shocking incident from Uttar Pradesh's Saharanpur has sparked outrage after a son was caught on CCTV allegedly assaulting his 72-year-old father in the middle of a street over a property dispute.

The incident occurred on Monday in the Qutubsher police station area. The accused, identified as Gulfishan, was later arrested by police after the video of the assault went viral on social media.

According to police, Tahseen and his son Gulfishan, residents of Mankamou, had been involved in a long-running dispute over property division.

The CCTV footage shows the elderly man sitting on a chair in a narrow lane when Gulfishan approaches him. After a brief conversation, the accused allegedly slaps his father and continues arguing with him.

The video further shows Gulfishan allegedly attempting to strangle his father before punching him multiple times. Despite the elderly man's efforts to defend himself, the assault continues before the accused eventually walks away from the scene.

The footage triggered widespread outrage online, with social media users tagging Saharanpur Police and demanding strict action against the accused.

Following the circulation of the video, police arrested Gulfishan and launched an investigation into the incident.

However, in a surprising development, the victim himself reportedly contacted the police and requested that his son be released. It is also reported that Tahseen reached out to Member of Parliament Imran Masood, seeking his son's release.

Qutubsher Station House Officer Santosh Tyagi said the father and son had been involved in a long-standing property dispute. He added that although police arrested the accused after the video surfaced, no formal complaint has been received from the family so far.

Police said the matter remains under investigation and further action will be taken based on the findings.

#Saharanpur #UttarPradesh #CCTVVideo #PropertyDispute #BreakingNews

articles.title: Truck Flips on Chitrakoot Bridge, Bolero Escapes Disaster by Seconds
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A terrifying accident caught on CCTV in Chitrakoot's Raipura area shows a speeding truck losing control and overturning on the Lalapur River Bridge.

body.html:
A terrifying accident caught on CCTV in Chitrakoot's Raipura area shows a speeding truck losing control and overturning on the Lalapur River Bridge. In a miraculous escape, a Bolero coming from the opposite direction avoided being crushed by mere seconds as the truck flipped and passed just inches above the vehicle. The dramatic footage has gone viral, leaving viewers stunned by the narrow escape.
